# Naos Gym Marsala

> > Naos Gym Marsala is a fitness and martial arts club in Marsala, Sicily, established in 1997, offering TRX training, martial arts programs, and comprehensive fitness facilities.

Naos Gym Societa Sportiva Dilettantistica A.r.l. operates as a full-service sports club in Marsala, featuring specialized training programs including martial arts instruction, TRX suspension training, and modern fitness facilities across multiple training rooms.
